statements.impact_statement: GraphQL Java 25.0 shades and relocates Guava, then minimizes the bundled classes. Its maintainer confirms that only immutable collections remain and the vulnerable deserialization gadget code is absent: https://github.com/graphql-java/graphql-java/pull/4498#issuecomment-6473483561. The vulnerable CompactHashMap and CompactHashSet classes are absent. The bundled MapMakerInternalMap rejects native deserialization with InvalidObjectException rather than performing the vulnerable allocation.
statements.action_statement: Reassess if the bundled GraphQL Java version or its relocated Guava contents change.
